name: @jonverrier/c4-auto
description: Automated C4 architecture documentation for TypeScript projects

scripts.test: mocha --no-config --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register --require ./test/md-require-hook.ts --extensions ts,js test/DirectoryTreeTraverser.test.ts test/ModuleHeaderVisitor.test.ts test/C4DiagramVisitor.test.ts test/DocumentationGenerator.integration.test.ts --exit
scripts.cover: nyc --reporter=lcov --reporter=text mocha --no-config --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register --require ./test/md-require-hook.ts --extensions ts,js test/DirectoryTreeTraverser.test.ts test/ModuleHeaderVisitor.test.ts test/C4DiagramVisitor.test.ts test/DocumentationGenerator.integration.test.ts --exit
